title: Late Fee Schedule - Fire & Smoke Mitigation
content:
Fire & Smoke Mitigation late fee figures by tier: the monthly percentage, the minimum fee, the grace days after the due date and the claim-pending suspension period.

## Schedule items

- Monthly late fee percentage: Late fee on the past-due balance per monthly fee period, percent.
- Late fee minimum: Minimum late fee per monthly fee period, USD.
- Grace days: Grace days after the due date before the first late fee may post, calendar days.
- Claim-pending suspension: Days after the final invoice date during which late fees are suspended on an insurance-funded job whose claim file is still awaiting carrier payment, calendar days.

## Figures by tier

| Tier | Late fee per monthly fee period | Late fee minimum (USD) | Grace days (calendar) | Claim-pending suspension (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Smoke Odor Response | 1.5 percent | 25.00 | 10 | 90 |
| Light Smoke and Soot Cleanup | 1.5 percent | 25.00 | 10 | 90 |
| Moderate Fire and Smoke Cleanup | 1.5 percent | 25.00 | 10 | 90 |
| Heavy Fire Cleanup | 1.5 percent | 25.00 | 10 | 90 |
| Structural Fire Large Loss | 1.5 percent | 25.00 | 10 | 90 |
| Commercial Fire Large Loss | 1.5 percent | 25.00 | 10 | 90 |

## Note

The four figures are uniform across the six tiers: 1.5 percent per monthly fee period, a minimum of 25.00 per monthly fee period, 10 grace days and a 90-day claim-pending suspension. The row of the job's own tier is the one read.
